chunk.text: Aircraft cabins are pressurized to counter that risk. People who plan to fly in high-altitude military aircraft breathe high levels of oxygen before the flight – much like astronauts do before a spacewalk – to help avoid decompression sickness. Formal risk description: Risk of mission impacts and long-term health issues due to decompression sickness Research in support of this risk: Latest evidence Explore more: Human System Risk Board resources Related Content View the Complete List of Human System Risks Read More Locked In, Pressure Low Read More Risk of Injury and Compromised Performance from Spacewalks Read More Artemis Spacesuits Read More
